letter_text.opening: I am excited to apply for the AI Engineer: Computer Vision, LLMs & ML role at Flexgen Construction Technology, a company that is revolutionizing the construction industry with its domain-aware AI tools, and I am particularly drawn to this position because of the opportunity to build RAG systems that understand construction terminology and domain-specific language.
body_paragraphs: With my experience in building and deploying ML systems across healthcare and retail/e-commerce, I believe I can leverage my strong Python skills and PyTorch expertise to tackle problems with no off-the-shelf answers on construction job sites. My work on the Patient Readmission Risk Predictor project has shown me the value of using SHAP values to produce clinician-facing explanations for each risk score, which aligns with the company's goal of making construction sites safer and more efficient.

I am also excited about the opportunity to deploy computer vision that detects safety violations from real-world job-site photos taken in poor lighting conditions. My experience with the Construction Site Safety Vision Monitor project has given me hands-on experience with YOLO object detection, which I believe can be adapted to this role. Furthermore, my work on the Customer Support RAG Chatbot project has shown me the potential of retrieval-augmented generation for improving customer support efficiency, a skill that could be valuable in this position.
letter_text.skills_line: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, RAG, embeddings, LangChain, vector databases, computer vision (YOLO, Segment Anything)
letter_text.closing: I am excited about the opportunity to contribute my skills and experience to Flexgen Construction Technology and help tackle problems in the construction industry. Thank you for considering my application.
